Questions and answers

What is Исключение из политики?

In this glossary, Исключение из политики refers to: A formally approved, documented deviation from an established security policy, typically granted on a temporary basis with compensating controls.

How is Исключение из политики used in cybersecurity?

In cybersecurity communication, this term appears in contexts such as: "Было предоставлено исключение из политики, чтобы унаследованные системы оставались онлайн до запланированного обновления."

Definition

A formally approved, documented deviation from an established security policy, typically granted on a temporary basis with compensating controls.

Operational example

A policy exception was granted to allow legacy systems to remain online until the scheduled upgrade.
